title: The Unofficial Homecoming
author: August Kavanagh
blurb: Theo Underhill, a debate champion who can't win the argument at home, has spent ten years being so careful it hurts. Then grandma's recipe box contains directions that aren't for food — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must expose what the school board buried, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
